Sorry never returning!
Feb 2026 • Friends
disappointing experience. We visited to celebrate a special occasion and left extremely dissatisfied.

We were given the wrong wine list twice, both containing errors. More importantly, the beef pho was served without bone marrow—one of the key components clearly shown on the menu—without any prior notice or explanation. Only after we questioned it were we told it was unavailable.

The apology felt robotic, with no empathy. No manager or supervisor came to address the issue. A 10% discount was applied at the bill as if it were a favor, not a genuine service recovery.

Staff attitude, especially while serving wine, was poor and unwelcoming. We spent nearly 2.5 million VND, but the issue wasn’t the money—it was the lack of professionalism and care.

Will not return and do not recommend.

Stylish! Food & drink are good are beautiful!
Jun 2024 • Couples
I felt like having dessert, and was drawn in by the nice-looking exterior.
The ceilings were high, and the European interior was lovely.
They had delicious looking cocktails, so I ordered a mojito and sangria instead of coffee.
For food, I chose banh mi and velvet cake.
Both were delicious, but the banh mi was so good I don't think I'll ever eat anywhere else.
The presentation was also beautiful.
Phouing, who was in charge of our table, was a friendly woman who loves Doraemon and is interested in Japanese, and her service was also excellent.
Some people have left reviews saying it's expensive, but I think the price is reasonable considering the quality.
